# Shuush

> Open-source local Superwhisper & Wispr Flow alternative for Linux and Wayland, built cleanly on top of MIT-licensed voxtype (https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype).

## Core Facts
- Repository: https://github.com/KitsuneKode/shuush
- License: MIT
- Platforms: Linux Wayland (Hyprland, Omarchy, Sway, Niri, Arch Linux) + first-party kuwai rice support
- GPU Backends (via voxtype): NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm/Vulkan, Intel Vulkan, CPU
- Speech Models (via voxtype): Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B fp16, Whisper large-v3-turbo, Cohere Transcribe GGUF, Moonshine
- Word Limits: None (unlimited local ASR; 1-click Air-Gapped Ollama offline mode or cloud failover via Groq/OpenRouter/Cerebras)

## Verified Real-World Benchmarks (Intel i5-13450HX, NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop 6 GB VRAM, 23 GiB RAM)
- Measured takes: 333 real coding & chat dictations
- Words dictated: 19,498 words (~8.1 hours saved vs 40 WPM typing)
- End-to-end cleanup latency: 516 ms P50, 1,060 ms P90 (24 ms when already clean)
- Cleanup reliability: 98.8% non-fallback rate
- Resident VRAM: ~2.3 GB (Parakeet fp16 on CUDA)

## Key Components
- [Landing Page](index.html): Overview, interactive 5-source diff explorer, Studio showcase, comparison vs Wispr Flow & Superwhisper
- [Architecture & Benchmarks Blog](blog.html): Deep dive into 5-source AT-SPI context, anti-paraphrase span gating, and non-poisoning phonetic self-learning
- [CLI & Installer](../install.sh): One-command drop-in setup on stock voxtype-bin (`./install.sh --wire-config`)
- [GTK4 + Libadwaita Studio](../libexec/voxtype-studio.py): Live history, inline diff inspector, usage insights, auto-mine, in-app API keys (chmod 600), air-gapped Ollama switch, drag-and-drop provider chain
- [KitsuneHud Quickshell Pill](../osd/kitsune-hud/KitsuneHud.qml): Liquid-glass waveform pill with word-wash live preview, polishing shimmer, and delivery checkmark
